title: Prelude
description: Switch between Nextendo Network and Nintendo's official network services.
author: Nextendo Network
details:
Prelude is a Nintendo Switch homebrew application for switching an Atmosphere console between Nextendo Network and Nintendo's official network services.

Nextendo mode configures the Atmosphere files and patches needed to connect supported games and services to Nextendo Network. Nintendo mode removes Prelude's changes and restores the console's normal Nintendo network configuration.

Prelude applies its changes through files and settings that Atmosphere reads at boot, making the process reversible. After selecting a network mode, the console reboots so the new configuration can take effect.
changelog:
v3.5.14

## Prelude v3.5.14

**New: Nintendo Switch Sports online on Nextendo.**

- Adds an explicit redirect for the Switch Sports game server (`g21f19300-lp1.s.n.srv.nintendo.net`), next to the other per-game NEX entries.
- The game's online data tables are now delivered by Nextendo's BCAT, the same way as Pokémon Legends: Z-A and Scarlet/Violet. Without them the game refuses to go online.
- Update, open Prelude once in Nextendo mode to apply the hosts, then **fully power off and restart** the console (the hosts file and the BCAT patch are only read at boot).
- Requires Nintendo Switch Sports 1.5.0 and a linked Nextendo account.

Known issues: matches with several players have not been tested yet.

Full changelog: https://github.com/NextendoNetwork/Prelude-Nextendo/compare/v3.5.13...v3.5.14
